panels.title: Live peers
panels.description: Peers this node's membership currently sees. Should equal cluster size minus one on every node; a lower steady value means a partition or a dead node.

panels.title: Open caches
panels.description: Named caches opened on this node. Differing values across nodes usually mean a service rollout in progress.

panels.title: Backlog drops (per peer)
panels.description: Rate of broadcast messages dropped by the bounded per-peer outboxes. Nonzero in steady state means the cluster is undersized for its write load — this is the honest signal, not a transient to ignore.

panels.title: Anti-entropy repairs
panels.description: Entries repaired per second by anti-entropy rounds. A burst after a partition heals is the system working; a sustained nonzero rate in a quiet cluster means broadcasts are being lost continuously.

panels.title: State-transfer records
panels.description: Records streamed to joining nodes. Spikes line up with node starts and warm joins.
